I posted the ticket list as a reply in #strategic-pod, addressed to you. It has five Vantorre Group tickets, each with its source:

1. **#8841** (Allentown gate kiosk timeout, Dock Door 12): #strategic-pod, Gideon, 2026-07-01. Moss's 5/4 digest lists it as open, and her 9/30 digest describes #8841 differently (Newark, Dock Door 14). The sources disagree, so check the ticket system.
2. **PD-8841** (two missed carrier check-ins, Allentown Gate 4): Moss digest 4/27/2026. It may be the same ticket as #8841 under another number.
3. **INC-4821** (Hartford kiosk outage and status-page access): #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 2026-08-03.
4. **VT-55120** (Hartford kiosk outage root cause): #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 2026-10-14.
5. **PD-4418** (Carrier_Dwell_Summary export dropping timestamps, Dock Door 9): Moss digest 9/15/2025. That digest says only "the account Nadia runs," so I inferred Vantorre Group from other digests. Please confirm.

I left out PD-4402 (Quillfeather) and #4812 (Vantorre Mobility). The 8/3 digest covers the Hartford incident but has no ticket number. I didn't use `search_messages`, so the list covers only the three sources you named.
